posts.author: RedBlizzard
posts.body: Hi, I was wondering if there were any plugins available for RMMV that allow me to show my character's faces during battle(side view), and change during certain conditions. Like if Character A was attacked, during the hit animation, it'd show their face reacting to taking the attack, similar to Persona and such. If anyone has any suggestions then please lmk! Thank you!
